title: Review answer key, format review-answer-key/1
description: What a review of ONE submittal should find. Written by a person, from the submittal and the standards alone, before the review runs. The scorer (scripts/review_score.py) compares a run's findings with it. Items are INVENTED for the sample key; a real key names the engineer who approved it.

name.description: Short neutral name; the weekly report matches a run file called <name>.findings.json.

source.description: invented: written to test the scorer. engineer_confirmed: a named engineer wrote or approved it (approved_by required). hidden_exam: the owner's hidden exam; scored only by the merger session (#650), never by the weekly report.

complete_for_flags.description: true when every real defect on the sheet is listed, so a flagged finding that matches no item is a false positive. false: such findings are reported as 'not judged by the key' and stay out of precision.

id.description: Unique. Reports name missed items by this id only.

kind.description: defect: a real breach or missing value; the review must flag it. met: complies; must not be flagged. trap: looks like a defect but is fine (an equivalent unit, a value exactly at the limit); flagging it is a trap false flag. not_applicable: does not apply to this submittal.

standard.description: A file name or document number; matched as a normalised substring of the finding's standard.

clause.description: Matches a finding at this clause or a subclause (4.2 matches 4.2.1, not 4.20).

field.description: Optional. Every word must appear in the finding's matched field or requirement text; makes the item more specific.

note.description: For humans. Never printed in a report.
